definition: Consignee Receipt and Acceptance Certificate. A document signed by the consignee (government department) confirming receipt and acceptance of goods or services, which triggers the invoice and payment process.
examples: CRAC no. GEM/2026/12345 issued against supply order SO-2026-0089
CRAC pending for invoice generation on completed supply order

definition: Goods Receipt Note. A warehouse or store document recording the receipt of goods into inventory, verifying quantity and quality against the purchase order.
examples: GRN-2026-0456 created for PO-2026-0234
Partial GRN raised for 50 units against PO for 100 units

definition: Original Equipment Manufacturer. The entity that manufactures the product or system being supplied, distinct from resellers or value-added partners.
examples: OEM certificate uploaded for vendor M/s ABC Electronics
OEM authorization letter required for brand-specific procurement

definition: Amount recoverable from a government department against posted invoice for goods or services supplied. Recorded as an asset in the books of accounts.
examples: Receivable of INR 5,00,000 against invoice INV-2026-0098 from Ministry of Defence
Ageing analysis shows 60-day overdue receivable of INR 2,30,000

definition: Amount payable to supplier or party after purchase or expense entry. Recorded as a liability in the books of accounts.
examples: Payable of INR 3,50,000 due to M/s XYZ Suppliers against Bill No. 7890
Payable ageing report generated for month-end closing

definition: Operational hold on a specific quantity of stock for a particular supply order before dispatch. Ensures committed stock is not diverted to other orders.
examples: Stock reserved: 200 units of Item A against supply order SO-2026-0102
Reservation released due to order cancellation

definition: Lowest qualified bidder in government procurement. The bidder who meets all qualification criteria and has quoted the lowest price, eligible for the Letter of Award.
examples: M/s Techno Solutions declared L1 in tender GEM/2026/RFP/0045
L1 price of INR 12,50,000 used for rate contract negotiation

definition: Letter of Acceptance / Letter of Award. A formal document issued by the procuring entity to the L1 bidder confirming the award of the contract or purchase order.
examples: LOA issued to M/s Delta Corp on 15-Jun-2026 for supply of IT equipment
LOA reference number GEM/LOA/2026/3342

definition: Cost of Goods Sold. The direct costs attributable to the goods supplied, including purchase cost, freight, insurance, and other directly allocable expenses.
examples: COGS for the quarter Q1 2026-27 computed at INR 85,00,000
Average COGS per unit calculated using weighted average method

definition: Goods and Services Tax. A comprehensive indirect tax levied on supply of goods and services in India, comprising CGST, SGST, and IGST components.
examples: GST rate of 18% applied on invoice INV-2026-0078
GST return GSTR-3B filed for May 2026

definition: Central Goods and Services Tax. The central government component of GST levied on intra-state supplies. Half of the total GST rate for intra-state transactions.
examples: CGST 9% charged on intra-state supply of INR 1,00,000
CGST output tax liability set off against CGST input tax credit

definition: State Goods and Services Tax. The state government component of GST levied on intra-state supplies. Half of the total GST rate for intra-state transactions.
examples: SGST 9% charged on intra-state supply of INR 1,00,000
SGST output tax liability set off against SGST input tax credit

definition: Integrated Goods and Services Tax. The GST component levied on inter-state supplies and imports. Collected by the central government and apportioned between centre and states.
examples: IGST 18% charged on inter-state supply from Delhi to Karnataka
IGST credit used first to pay IGST liability, then CGST/SGST in cross-utilization

definition: Tax Deducted at Source. Income tax deducted by the payer (government department) on payments made to suppliers as per Income Tax Act provisions, typically under Section 194C, 194J, etc.
examples: TDS @ 2% under Section 194C deducted on contractor payment of INR 5,00,000
TDS certificate Form 16A issued to supplier for FY 2025-26

definition: GST deducted at source under Section 194Q of the Income Tax Act, or under GST TDS provisions (Section 51 of CGST Act) where specified government departments deduct TDS on supplies exceeding threshold.
examples: GST TDS @ 2% (1% CGST + 1% SGST) deducted on supply value exceeding INR 2,50,000
GST TDS certificate uploaded on the GST portal

definition: Harmonized System of Nomenclature code for item classification. A standardized numerical system used to classify traded products for customs and GST purposes.
examples: HSN code 8471.30 for laptop computers
HSN summary required in GSTR-1 for supplies exceeding INR 5,000 per invoice

definition: Unique Transaction Reference for bank payments. A unique alphanumeric code assigned by the banking system (NEFT/RTGS/IMPS) to identify a specific fund transfer transaction.
examples: UTR SBIN123456789012 for NEFT payment of INR 2,00,000
Payment reconciled using UTR mapped to bank statement line

definition: Earnest Money Deposit. A refundable deposit submitted by bidders along with their tender to guarantee their commitment to the bidding process. Forfeited if the bidder withdraws or fails to honour the award.
examples: EMD of INR 50,000 submitted via bank guarantee with tender GEM/2026/0112
EMD refunded to unsuccessful bidders after LOA issuance

definition: Government e-Marketplace. The online platform for public procurement in India, operated by the Government of India, enabling government departments to purchase goods and services from registered sellers.
examples: Supply order raised through GeM portal for office stationery
GeM contract no. GEMC-2026-IT-005678

definition: Accounting document recording a financial transaction. Types include payment, receipt, journal, contra, credit note, debit note, and purchase/sales vouchers.
examples: Payment voucher PV-2026-0034 for INR 1,75,000 to M/s XYZ
Journal voucher JV-2026-0021 for depreciation adjustment

definition: Account-wise record of financial transactions. Each ledger aggregates all debits and credits for a specific account head such as bank, supplier, customer, or expense.
examples: Bank of India ledger shows balance of INR 15,00,000 as on 30-Jun-2026
Supplier ledger for M/s ABC Corp extracted for reconciliation

definition: List of all ledger balances at a given date to verify the accounting equation debit equals credit. Used as a basis for preparing financial statements.
examples: Trial Balance as on 30-Jun-2026 shows total debits of INR 2,50,00,000
Trial Balance generated for branch office for quarterly closing

definition: Control view for source records (such as purchase orders, invoices, payments) that are waiting to create accounting impact. Allows users to review and post vouchers in batch.
examples: 25 pending purchase invoices in posting queue awaiting GL mapping
Posting queue cleared for month-end closing

definition: Maker-checker view for sensitive transaction approval. Sensitive operations require one user to create (maker) and another to approve (checker) before execution.
examples: Journal voucher JV-2026-0015 pending in approval queue for CFO approval
Three payment proposals awaiting checker approval in approval queue

definition: System evidence of critical create, edit, delete, and post actions. Records who performed what action, at what time, and from which IP, providing non-repudiation for audit trails.
examples: Audit log shows user admin@org modified supplier bank details on 15-Jun-2026
Audit trail extracted for statutory audit of FY 2025-26

definition: Invoice-wise receivable or payable position showing the remaining amount for each individual bill after partial payments, credits, or allocations.
examples: Bill-wise outstanding report shows INV-2026-0045 has INR 50,000 remaining
Partial payment of INR 75,000 applied leaving bill-wise outstanding of INR 25,000

definition: Linking a receipt (payment received) to specific invoices to close outstanding receivables. Enables accurate tracking of which bills are paid and which remain due.
examples: Receipt of INR 1,00,000 allocated to INV-2026-0032 and INV-2026-0033
Auto-allocation of receipt against oldest outstanding invoices

definition: Linking supplier payment to specific purchase bills to close payables. Ensures each purchase invoice is tracked for payment status and ageing.
examples: Payment of INR 2,00,000 allocated to purchase bills PB-2026-0012 and PB-2026-0014
Supplier allocation report generated for monthly closing

definition: Cash to bank or bank to bank movement without profit and loss impact. Used for fund transfers between accounts, cash deposits, and withdrawals.
examples: Contra voucher CV-2026-0010 for transfer from SBI to Bank of India of INR 5,00,000
Cash deposited INR 50,000 recorded via contra voucher

definition: Voucher reducing sales, receivable, and GST liability due to return of goods, rate difference, or invoice correction. Issued by the supplier to the buyer.
examples: Credit note CN-2026-0015 issued for return of defective items worth INR 25,000
Credit note for rate difference adjustment in GST portal

definition: Voucher reducing supplier payable due to return of goods, rate difference, or purchase invoice correction. Issued by the buyer to the supplier.
examples: Debit note DN-2026-0008 raised against supplier for short delivery
Debit note adjustment reflected in GSTR-2A

definition: Annual accounting period for financial reporting. In India, the financial year runs from 1 April to 31 March. All books of accounts are maintained and closed per financial year.
examples: Books closed for FY 2025-26 on 31-Mar-2026
Financial year 2026-27 opened with opening balances as on 01-Apr-2026

definition: Moving closing balances of all ledgers from one financial year to the next as opening balances. Includes assets, liabilities, income, expense, and reserves.
examples: Profit and Loss balance carried forward to retained earnings for FY 2026-27
All ledger balances carried forward from FY 2025-26 to FY 2026-27

definition: Starting balance brought into the system at the time of ERP go-live for each ledger account. Represents the financial position as on the go-live date.
examples: Opening balance of INR 10,00,000 entered for Bank of India account at go-live
Opening stock balance of 500 units entered for Item A during migration

definition: Dispatch document for supply to department or consignee. Accompanies the physical movement of goods and records item details, quantity, and destination.
examples: Delivery challan DC-2026-0089 generated for dispatch of 100 laptops
e-Way bill linked to delivery challan for goods movement above threshold

definition: Shortage identified from order demand versus available stock. A system-generated or manual trigger to initiate the procurement cycle for items falling below reorder level.
examples: Procurement requirement raised for 300 units of Item B based on reorder point alert
MRP-driven procurement requirement for production of 500 units

definition: Duration for which stock has been reserved for a specific order. Helps identify stale reservations that need review, release, or escalation.
examples: Reservation ageing report showing 30-day-old reservation for SO-2026-0056
Stale reservation of 45 days flagged for manager review

definition: Comparison of billing value against costs showing net margin for a supply order, contract, or business unit. Includes material cost, overheads, and indirect expenses.
examples: Supply order SO-2026-0089 shows profitability of 12.5% net margin
Contract profitability report generated for management review

definition: Draft accounting suggestion generated from bank import or operational event. Requires review and promotion to a formal voucher before posting.
examples: Voucher proposal generated from bank statement import for 25 transactions
Auto-generated voucher proposal for salary disbursement reviewed by accountant

definition: Process of transitioning from setup and development to live production operation of the ERP system. Includes data migration, user training, and cutover from legacy systems.
examples: Go-live scheduled for 01-Apr-2026 with opening balance migration
Post go-live support period of 30 days for issue resolution
